title: FY27 Professional Services
short_description: County of Maui seeks pre-qualified consultants for countywide building-related professional services.
project_scope: Request for qualifications to establish a pre-qualified list of consulting firms for fiscal year 2027 countywide projects and technical services. The notice states 'All Disciplines Requested' and does not define specific buildings, structures, sizes, spans, gross floor areas, or individual project scopes.
services: Professional consulting services for countywide projects and technical services; exact planning disciplines and service phases are not specified.
relevance_explanation:
- This is a general pre-qualification/framework-style solicitation without a defined technical project.
- No specific bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structure is identified.
- 'All Disciplines Requested' is too broad and provides no clear structural engineering entry point.
- sbp guidance explicitly deprioritizes framework agreements without technical specification.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated. The notice is only for establishing a pre-qualified consultant list for future countywide projects, with no defined project scope, size, or technical parameters that would allow a realistic cost estimate.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. Because this is a general pre-qualification for unspecified future assignments, no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the notice.
references_qualifications: Statements of qualifications from professional consulting firms are requested to establish a pre-qualified list. No specific reference counts, project types, fee zones, or minimum qualification thresholds are stated in the notice excerpt.

notes: Project number: PROFSVCFY27. Target market: General Building. Countywide scope. Multiple contracts may be awarded. Contract duration: 12 months. Questions deadline: 2026-05-29 05:00 PM HST.
